description: Public SDK methods kept for one more minor version after the API contract dropped them (docs/DESIGN.md section 3.1). Written by codegen/spec_sync.py, keyed by resource.method. reason is removed (the operation left the contract) or renamed (its x-didit-sdk naming changed; replacement names the new method). Each entry holds the fully dereferenced operation, so it never depends on the current documents. tests/test_contract.py fails once the package version reaches remove_in: delete the entry and regenerate in that release.
